note: Narration for demo30.html (30-second Space Apps demo). Generated with edge-tts (Microsoft neural TTS); not an actor recording.

lines.h: Hello. My name is Ling Yew Han. For Abandoned but not Forgotten, Malaysia's Wayang Kulit inspired Shadows Left Behind.
lines.g1: Your hand is tracked live in AR. Wave, and the shadow puppets move.
lines.g2: Pinch to scan the rocks, and real NASA images reveal Opportunity's discoveries.
lines.g3: Next come Voyager and the Apollo rover. Abandoned, but not forgotten.
lines.g0: Pick a storybook. Oppy's book opens and pulls you in.
